description: This file defines an Android activity class 'NoteDetailActivity' responsible for displaying, editing, and deleting a note within a note-taking app. It manages UI elements, menu actions, and data retrieval through a repository.

classes.name: NoteDetailActivity
classes.description: Android activity for displaying detailed information about a note, with options to edit or delete.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, UI components, and loads the note based on intent extra.

methods.name: loadNote
methods.description: Fetches the note from the repository asynchronously and binds it to UI.

methods.name: bindNote
methods.description: Populates the UI with data from the note object.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the menu options for editing and deleting the note.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu actions such as edit, delete, and navigate up.
